cards.ex: Some influencers are trying to game the system by buying fake followers.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi ta'sir o'tkazuvchilar soxta obunachilar sotib olib, tizimni aldamoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Tizimni o'z foydasiga ishlatish uchun manipulyatsiya qilish, noqonuniy usullar bilan foyda ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Sensationalist headlines feed into public anxiety about technology.
cards.exUz: Sensatsion sarlavhalar texnologiya haqidagi jamoatchilik xavotirlarini kuchaytiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning kuchayishiga yoki rivojlanishiga sabab bo'lmoq, qo'shimcha ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: We're living in the attention economy, where everyone is vying for our clicks.
cards.exUz: Biz diqqat iqtisodiyotida yashayapmiz, unda hamma bizning bosishlarimiz uchun kurashadi.
cards.uzDef: Insonlarning diqqatini jalb qilish orqali pul ishlashga qaratilgan biznes modeli.

cards.ex: That app became popular virtually overnight.
cards.exUz: Bu ilova deyarli bir kechada mashhur bo'lib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va qisqa vaqt ichida, bir kechada deyarli.

cards.ex: Being a digital nomad allows you to travel the world while working.
cards.exUz: Raqamli ko'chmanchi bo'lish sizga ishlash bilan birga dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish imkonini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan foydalanib, uzoqdan ishlaydigan va turli joylarda yashovchi odam.

cards.ex: Social media can amplify the echo chamber effect.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media aks-sado xonasi effektini kuchaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash fikrlarga ega odamlar bilan o'z fikrlarini takrorlash orqali mustahkamlash.

cards.ex: Her online persona is very different from who she is in real life.
cards.exUz: Uning onlayn shaxsi haqiqiy hayotda qandayligidan juda farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Internetdagi ijtimoiy media va boshqa platformalarda yaratilgan shaxsning obrazi.

cards.ex: I went down the rabbit hole researching conspiracy theories last night.
cards.exUz: Men kecha kechqurun fitna nazariyalarini tadqiq qilib, chuqur kirib ketdim.
cards.term: to go down the rabbit hole
cards.uzDef: Bir mavzuga qiziqib, unga chuqur kirib ketib, vaqtni sezmay qolmoq.

cards.ex: The modern information ecosystem is complex and often overwhelming.
cards.exUz: Zamonaviy axborot ekotizimi murakkab va ko'pincha haddan tashqari yuklaydi.
cards.uzDef: Turli manbalardan keladigan axborot oqimi va ularning o'zaro ta'siri.

cards.ex: YouTube thrives on user-generated content.
cards.exUz: YouTube foydalanuvchilar tomonidan yaratilgan kontent orqali rivojlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Foydalanuvchilar tomonidan yaratilgan va internetda tarqatilgan kontent (matn, video, rasm).

cards.ex: Social media can reinforce confirmation bias.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media tasdiqlash xatosini kuchaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrlarini tasdiqlovchi ma'lumotlarni qidirish va ularga e'tibor berish tendensiyasi.

cards.ex: The internet is shortening our attention spans.
cards.exUz: Internet bizning diqqat davomiyligimizni qisqartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir narsaga yo'naltirish va ushlab turish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Everyone is wondering what the next big thing in tech will be.
cards.exUz: Hamma texnologiyadagi keyingi katta narsa nima bo'lishini o'ylayapti.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada juda mashhur va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: We're on the same wavelength when it comes to online privacy.
cards.exUz: Onlayn maxfiylik haqida gap ketganda, biz bir xil to'lqindamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrlash, tushunish va his qilish.

cards.ex: Voice cloning technology is raising ethical concerns.
cards.exUz: Ovoz klonlash texnologiyasi axloqiy muammolarni keltirib chiqarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sun'iy intellekt yordamida biror kishining ovozini nusxalash.

cards.ex: Be careful about oversharing on social media.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda haddan tashqari ko'p oshkor qilishdan ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni haddan tashqari ko'p ulashish.

cards.ex: The Internet of Things is changing the way we live.
cards.exUz: Narsalar interneti bizning hayot tarzimizni o'zgartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Internetga ulangan qurilmalar tarmog'i.

cards.ex: There's a growing demand for algorithmic transparency.
cards.exUz: Algoritm oshkoraligiga talab ortib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Algoritmlarning qanday ishlashini tushuntirish va ularning ta'sirini oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: Users can flag inappropriate content on the platform.
cards.exUz: Foydalanuvchilar platformada nomaqbul kontentni belgilashlari mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kontentni nomaqbul deb belgilash va uni ko'rib chiqish uchun yuborish.

cards.ex: If you have any questions, please reach out to our support team.
cards.exUz: Agar sizda savollar bo'lsa, iltimos, bizning qo'llab-quvvatlash guruhimiz bilan bog'laning.
cards.uzDef: Bilan aloqa o'rnatmoq, yordam yoki ma'lumot so'ramoq.

cards.ex: This device is plug and play, so it's very easy to set up.
cards.exUz: Bu qurilma 'uladi va ishlat', shuning uchun uni o'rnatish juda oson.
cards.uzDef: Oson o'rnatiladigan va ishlatish uchun murakkab sozlash talab qilmaydigan.

cards.ex: That celebrity's post almost broke the internet.
cards.exUz: U mashhurning posti deyarli internetni portlatdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mashhur bo'lib, hamma tomonidan muhokama qilinadigan narsa.

cards.ex: Social listening helps companies understand their customers better.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tinglash kompaniyalarga o'z mijozlarini yaxshiroq tushunishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy mediada brend, mahsulot yoki mavzu haqida gapirilganlarni kuzatish.

cards.ex: The digital divide widens with every new technological advancement.
cards.exUz: Har bir yangi texnologik taraqqiyot bilan raqamli tafovut kengaymoqda.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan foydalanish imkoniyati bo'lganlar va bo'lmaganlar o'rtasidagi farqning ortishi.

cards.ex: I turned off push notifications to reduce distractions.
cards.exUz: Diqqatni chalg'itmaslik uchun bildirishnomalarni o'chirib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Mobil ilovalar tomonidan yuboriladigan xabarlar.

cards.ex: We're experiencing bandwidth constraints due to high traffic.
cards.exUz: Yuqori trafik tufayli tarmoq cheklovlarini boshdan kechirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Internet tezligi yoki ma'lumotlar uzatish hajmidagi cheklovlar.

cards.ex: That video went viral within hours of being posted.
cards.exUz: Bu video joylashtirilgandan so'ng bir necha soat ichida ommaga tarqaldi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda juda tez va keng tarqalmoq, ommaga mashhur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Digital literacy skills are essential in today's world.
cards.exUz: Raqamli savodxonlik ko'nikmalari bugungi kunda juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan samarali va xavfsiz foydalanish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Review your privacy settings to protect your personal information.
cards.exUz: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni himoya qilish uchun maxfiylik sozlamalaringizni ko'rib chiqing.
cards.uzDef: Onlayn ma'lumotlaringizni kim ko'rishini boshqarish uchun sozlamalar.

cards.ex: We need to future-proof our technology investments.
cards.exUz: Biz texnologiya investitsiyalarimizni kelajakka moslashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi o'zgarishlarga bardosh bera oladigan va eskirib qolmaydigan.
